name: remotex
description: Operate remote systems with confirmed profile setup, physical Windows host admission, reusable credential aliases, secure local credential lifecycle tools, bounded execution, verified transfer, VM identity, snapshots, and cooperative leases.

interface.shortDescription: Operate remote systems with bounded execution
interface.longDescription: Use OpenSSH, Remote Desktop, WinRM, govc, vmrun, and isolated Edge with named profiles, local credentials, identity checks, FIFO leases and audit records. One local site/account approval starts automatic web login and covers ordinary task reads, buttons, forms and business changes for up to 12 hours, with separate sensitive-action confirmation, expiry and revocation. Existing granular sessions retain exact resource review.
